question: Which organization initially managed the Women’s ODI World Cup till 2005 before ICC took over?
solution:
The correct answer is __**International Women’s Cricket Council (IWCC).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The International Women’s Cricket Council (IWCC) initially organized the Women’s World Cup before ICC assumed responsibility in 2005.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• IWCC organized the first edition in **1973.**
 
• It managed women’s cricket globally until **2005.**
 
• After 2005, the **ICC integrated women’s cricket** under its governance.
 
• The integration led to better funding and global expansion.
 
• Women’s cricket tournaments became ICC flagship events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **First World Cup Host:** England (1973)
 
• **Current Organizer:** International Cricket Council (ICC)
 
• **2025 Host:** India and Sri Lanka
 
• **Winner (2025):** India Women
 
• **Format:** Round-robin and knockout stages
